posts.title: It’s Time to Move On
posts.description: I think it’s time to say goodbye. When I started this blog, I didn’t really know what I was getting myself into. It became a place where I could experiment, learn, and, in a strange way, step into the lives of other people for a little while. There was something genuinely interesting about that, entering someone else’s world and seeing how they experienced things. I’m grateful for that experience.

posts.title: Why Some Movies Are Worth Going Into Debt For (Yes, I Bought a Ticket to The Odyssey)
posts.description: Some years ago, more specifically when Top Gun: Maverick was released, something not so unusual happened. I was too broke to see it in theaters. A few months later, I finally watched it at home, and I regretted missing it on the big screen. Every fifteen minutes I caught myself thinking, "This would have looked incredible in a theater."
